text: dsh-tray 是面向桌面版 DSH 的系统托盘插件。它通过 DSH Host 网关连接桌面壳的本机控制服务，并在 General 设置中加入托盘设置面板。用户可以启用或关闭托盘、选择关闭主窗口时隐藏到托盘还是退出应用、查看托盘和窗口状态，也可以重新打开窗口或退出应用；设置会保存并在启动时恢复。适合希望把 DSH 留在后台运行、避免误关窗口的桌面用户。需要桌面 DSH 壳提供 loopback 控制服务，不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-tray adds tray settings to desktop DSH. Users can enable the tray, choose whether closing hides or quits, check status, reopen the window, or quit. Preferences persist across restarts. It requires the desktop shell's local control service; no API key or external account is needed.
想把桌面版 DSH 缩到系统托盘继续运行。
DSH 点关闭窗口时能不能只隐藏，不要退出？
让 DSH 桌面应用在后台保留一个托盘图标。
误点关闭之后，希望还能从托盘把主窗口叫回来。
Keep the desktop app running in the system tray when I close its window.
How can I reopen my DSH window from the tray after hiding it?
dsh-tray 的功能「启用系统托盘」：在 General 设置面板打开或关闭托盘图标。开关变更后立即发送配置到桌面壳，并保存设置供下次启动恢复。
dsh-tray 的功能「关闭时隐藏或退出」：用户可在设置中选择关闭主窗口时隐藏到托盘或退出应用；默认行为是隐藏到托盘，配置会持久化。
dsh-tray 的功能「查看托盘状态」：设置面板读取桌面壳报告的托盘可用性、启用状态、关闭行为和窗口可见性；无桌面控制服务时显示不可用提示。
dsh-tray 的功能「显示窗口或退出应用」：托盘菜单包含打开主窗口和退出项，设置界面也提供退出按钮；操作通过桌面壳的本机控制服务执行。
dsh-tray 依赖桌面壳在本机提供 loopback 控制服务；缺少有效控制端口时功能会显示不可用，普通 dsh web 环境不会控制系统托盘。
桌面版 DSH 能提供托盘菜单来打开窗口和退出吗？
I want the tray preference to survive restarting the desktop app.

dsh-tray README · dsh-tray：**English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A small plugin that hides the desktop DSH into the system tray, avoiding the
risk of the app being accidentally closed by clicking "Close".

> Note: This plugin only works with the desktop DSH. Installing it on the Web
> side will have no effect.

dsh-tray README · Install：Search this repository in the plugin settings interface and click install
(requires the plugin marketplace to be installed), or from the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:cjz-wr/dsh-tray
```

dsh-tray README · Install：`<name>` is a placeholder — replace it with the profile you want to install
into, e.g. `dsh plugin --profile web add github:cjz-wr/dsh-tray`. The official
DeepSeek Harness does not ship this tray, so installing into the standard
`web` profile works fine. The only conflict is with builds that already
compose a `tray` row in-box (such as the repo this package was extracted
from) — see the note below.

A newly installed bundle layer composes on the next process boot.

dsh-tray README · Install：> **Build output is committed on purpose.** Git installs pull the repository as
> it is — nothing runs your `build` script. `lib/` is therefore committed so
> git/npm/tarball installs all work with zero build authorization; there is no
> `prepare` script. Rebuild locally with `npm run build` and commit the new
> `lib/` whenever `src/` changes.

dsh-tray README · Install：> ⚠️ **Conflict only with builds that already ship the tray.** The official
> DeepSeek Harness does **not** include this tray — it is a standalone add-on,
> so it installs cleanly into any profile, `web` included. The one exception:
> a build that already composes a row with the id `tray` (e.g. the modified
> repo this package was extracted from, whose
> `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` adds it) fails at boot with
> `duplicate loader entry id: tray` when this bundle mounts on top. In that
> case, install into a profile that does not include the built-in row.

dsh-tray README · Contents：- `src/` — TypeScript sources (Host gateway + client settings face).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the `dsh.bundle` patch layer (one loader row).
- `lib/` — build output, committed (see note above).
- `node_modules/` — local SDK junction links, git-ignored (not needed by users).

dsh-tray README · Build：```sh
npm run build
```

Requires the harness toolchain (typescript + tsdown) resolvable at build time;
the extracted folder links the SDK packages it peers on.

dsh-tray README · dsh-tray：**中文** | [English](README.md)

一个可以将桌面端 DSH 隐藏到系统托盘的小插件，避免误点「关闭」导致应用意外退出的风险。

> 注意：该插件仅适用于桌面端 DSH，在 Web 端安装无法生效。

dsh-tray README · 安装：在 插件设置界面中搜索本仓库并点击安装(前提是安装了插件市场)，或通过命令行安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:cjz-wr/dsh-tray
```

`<name>` 是占位符，请替换成你要安装的 profile 名称，例如 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:cjz-wr/dsh-tray`。官方 DeepSeek Harness **没有内置**本托盘，装进标准的 `web` profile 完全没问题。唯一的冲突场景是：你的构建**已经内置了 `tray` 行**（例如本插件来源的那个被修改过的仓库）——见下方说明。

新安装的 bundle 层将在下次进程启动时组合生效。

dsh-tray README · 安装：> **构建产物是特意提交的。** Git 安装会按仓库原样拉取——不会运行你的 `build` 脚本。因此 `lib/` 被提交到仓库中，这样 git/npm/tarball 安装都无需任何构建授权即可使用；这里没有 `prepare` 脚本。每当 `src/` 发生变化时，请使用 `npm run build` 在本地重新构建并提交新的 `lib/`。

> ⚠️ **仅与已内置托盘的构建冲突。** 官方 DeepSeek Harness **没有**包含本托盘——它是独立的附加插件，装进任何 profile（包括 `web`）都不会冲突。唯一的例外：如果某个构建已经组合了 `id` 为 `tray` 的行（例如本插件来源的那个被修改过的仓库，其 `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml` 添加了该行），再叠装本 bundle 会因 `duplicate loader entry id: tray` 启动失败。这种情况请装进不含内置行的 profile。

dsh-tray README · 目录结构：- `src/` — TypeScript 源码（Host 网关 + 客户端设置界面）。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — `dsh.bundle` 补丁层（一行 loader）。
- `lib/` — 构建输出，已提交（见上方说明）。
- `node_modules/` — 本地 SDK 链接，git 已忽略（用户无需使用）。

dsh-tray README · 构建：```sh
npm run build
```

构建时需要可解析的 harness 工具链（typescript + tsdown）；抽取出的文件夹链接了它所依赖的 SDK 包。
